codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: Are there any working Make Ramen To Get Rich codes?
items.answer: Not yet. As of October 19, 2026, the developers have released no codes - the official game description and group page list none. The codes page is re-checked after every game update.

items.question: Who made Make Ramen To Get Rich?
items.answer: The Roblox group "more ramen yum", which had about 72,000 members on October 19, 2026. The game released on October 8, 2026.

items.question: How do you get rich in the game?
items.answer: The official loop: cook ramen, record yourself eating it, and build a rich, famous mukbang persona. The beginner guide explains the flow, and verified numbers land as testing finishes.

items.question: Is Make Ramen To Get Rich free?
items.answer: Yes - like all Roblox games it is free to play through the Roblox app or website.
